notes.title: 50% Off Sale With New Winter Update!
notes.content:
Attention all colorful unicorn players!

In celebration of the Steam Lunar New Year, we are slashing the price of Unicorns on Unicycles in half. However, if you haven't noticed there was a major winter update to the game featuring new content.

Princess Starlight pretends to be a damsel in distress. She is “ambushed” by a horde of Snowlings and it’s up to Sir Slashy and Ozzo to save her from her situation. Ozzo reveals a softer side to himself and his unique ways with the women of the species.

[u][b]Game Update Features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] 1 New Character: A snowman unicorn called Princess Snowy Twinkles
[*] 1 new Level: Winter Magic
[*] 1 New Survival Story Mode: A Knight to Remember (featuring Sir Slashy going on a date with Princess Snowy Twinkles)
[*] 5 New Perks: BlastHorn, BullRush, Static Discharge, Jetpack, Trailblazer
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Oct 20
notes.content:
• All new rogue-like game mode called Survival Legends featuring 33 unique selectable perks to change how you play the game.
• Choose from 4 episodes to play including Curses & Corpses, a spooktacular storyline where Rumpus must defend himself from a horde of zombie unicorns!
• Three brand new PvP levels to joust against your friends, but be careful not to fall into the deadly booby traps.
• Four wacky new unicorns to choose from including a delicious, but deadly gummy bear unicorn named Gummy. 
• Razer Chroma RGB integrated
